hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A permissionless Uniswap v4 hook that runs a per-pool buyback pot: after every swap on a configured pool, it uses a fee-funded balance to buy the pool's designated main asset (in either swap direction), sized by liquidity depth and fees, rate-limited by a time-based spend bucket, and gated on a time-weighted reference tick. Supports an optional auto-compounding LP program with configurable fee splits (burn, refuel, recipient).
